reviews.text:
If you're looking for a special place for your dog, Manu Dog Camp is the best choice you can make! 🐾
I started attending the center 5 years ago and immediately felt at home from the first moment. In Chiara and Tatiana, I found not only two impeccable professionals, but two people with extraordinary sensitivity and a unique empathy for truly understanding dogs.
Thanks to their support, we've embarked on an extraordinary sporting journey, full of milestones and immense satisfaction!
If you want a team of experts to guide you step by step in establishing perfect harmony and a peaceful relationship with your four-legged companion, MANU DOG CAMP is absolutely the right place. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We've been coming to the center for over a year now. We started with an education program and stayed with Chiara for the scent and nose detection discipline. We're very happy with it; Iago has become an expert "nose," and every lesson is a chance for him to unwind and have fun. The facility is well-maintained, and the entire staff is highly trained and professional. I would recommend Chiara, Riccardo, & Co. to anyone.

The Manu Dog Camp canine center can be considered a 5-star resort for dogs. All the staff are efficient and highly qualified, as well as kind and always available to help dogs and their owners. During daycare, the dogs are constantly supervised and play in complete peace. In the summer, there are paddling pools available, and in the winter, they are sheltered even in the event of rain. A guarantee of quality and peace of mind.

Thank you, Piero, for your review! 🐾
We're happy your experience with Manu Dog Camp was positive.

Every review helps us better understand our work and our approach to interacting with dogs and families.

Best regards from all the staff 💚
Great experience. My dog ​​was afraid of everything and wouldn't respond to any commands. Many problems solved. The girls are amazing. A huge thank you.

I've been attending Manu Camp Dog with Domitilla for two years now, and I can only express my gratitude for the journey we've shared.
Over this time, I've seen Domitilla grow day after day, improving in so many ways, and achieving results I honestly never would have imagined. Thanks to the professionalism, expertise, and passion of Chiara and the entire staff.
Every lesson is an opportunity to learn something new, in a calm and welcoming environment.
Chiara is a well-prepared professional and always available, but what really makes the difference is her humanity.
I recommend Manu Camp Dog to anyone who wants to build a more informed, balanced, and profound relationship with their dog.
A heartfelt thank you to Chiara and all the staff for the commitment, patience, and dedication you show every day. For me and Domitilla, you have been and continue to be a precious source of inspiration. 🐾❤️

Good, competent, kind. In a word: magnificent.
A solution to every problem and plenty of advice.
The daycare service is excellent.

I've been going
for 3 years now; in fact, we've been going to the dog training center for 3 years. I went out of desperation 😁😁
Chiara is a very knowledgeable, helpful, and friendly instructor... like the rest of the team.
Thanks to her, I understood the relationship between us humans and our four-legged friends!!! I've always had dogs, but I still hadn't fully understood some aspects 😁..
We learned the very important basics of training a dog....
Of course, the path wasn't the easiest at the beginning,
because I always had my own ideas (often wrong),
like the use of the kennel, which is often used only for safe transport in the car, but is instead an excellent safety tool for the dog, a refuge where he can relax.
I understood over time, a loooong time, that with it you only indulge a dog's natural instincts, especially agitated or super hyperactive dogs like mine..😁 Sometimes I also take him to dog shelter where she has a lot of fun. With them I also took up the dog sport of rally obedience, an excellent activity that helps strengthen the bond of trust between dog and owner...what can I say...a welcoming and professional but at the same time down-to-earth place. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT for anyone who wants top-notch daily management with their dogs and resolution. of various behavioral problems..🐶😘 .. thank you CHAI

I've been attending Manu Dog Camp for 9 years with my American Staffordshire, Rock. We've tried Scent Detection, Rally Obedience, and the Ud Game: all experiences were great!
Super knowledgeable staff, a positive environment, and a passion for dogs. It's the ideal place to grow, learn, and have fun together.
